memories.content: Keep the total, major cost categories, and one-line estimate basis in the main text so the resource argument can be understood without leaving the proposal.
Place each major cost beside the activity or deliverable it enables in the main text.
State the quantity and unit-rate basis for each major cost in the same paragraph that requests it.
Readers may question a proposed priority when its cost cannot be checked on the same page as the claimed benefit.
Update the cost sentence whenever the related activity changes so the narrative and requested amount cannot drift apart.
Accept a denser main-text paragraph when the estimate basis is essential to deciding whether the request is proportionate.
The user tends to revise the work plan but forget a detached budget table unless the key amount is repeated beside the activity.
Mark unverified schedule assumptions as such.
Mark unverified recruitment assumptions as such.
Mark unverified technical assumptions as such.
Trace back the resources required for each core prototype feature and field research procedure.
Operations reviewers judge feasibility by examining the personnel required for each procedure.
Operations reviewers judge feasibility by examining the equipment required for each procedure.
Operations reviewers judge feasibility by examining the time required for each procedure.
Document separately the commitments and confirmation status of field partners required for recruitment, installation, and operational support.
Designate a responsible party for software updates, equipment inspections, and user support during the deployment period.
The user's deployment readiness can be assessed only when dependencies on external services and field personnel are visible.
Field schedules and assigned personnel may change due to operational factors beyond the researcher’s control.

analysis.overview: Both frames favor tracing resources to the work they enable. The reference otherwise concentrates on presenting, checking, and maintaining cost estimates in the proposal narrative, while the compared frame adds assumption labeling, operational dependencies, partner commitments, deployment ownership, and changing field conditions.

relations.reason: Activity-level cost placement and procedure-level tracing of personnel, equipment, and time can jointly govern resource justification and materially address the same traceability policy.
relations.summary: Resource requirements should be visibly tied to the activities, features, deliverables, or procedures they enable so feasibility can be assessed.

reports.both: Resources and costs should be traceable to the activities, features, or procedures they enable so feasibility can be evaluated.
reports.compared_only: The compared frame covers unverified assumptions, partner confirmation, deployment responsibilities, dependency visibility, and operationally driven schedule or staffing changes.
reports.reference_only: The reference emphasizes visible estimate totals and bases, same-page cost checking, synchronized revisions, and tolerating necessary narrative density.
